Every speed-up on this page is a ratio measured in one job: Shape and the baseline library it replaces run the same workload on the same machine, each in a fresh process, and the median of the runs is reported. **A workload's numbers are published only after its equivalence verifier exited 0**: Shape's output must be statistically equivalent to the baseline's (same tables, columns, distributions and relationships within fixed tolerances, with fixed seeds) before any timing counts. A workload whose verifier did not pass is listed without numbers.
